architecture.frontend: Pure ES6 Vanilla JavaScript Modules, HTML5, Tailwind CSS (CDN), Phosphor Icons (CDN)
architecture.backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL 15+, PostgREST API, Stored Procedures/RPC, Storage, Auth)
architecture.global_window_bindings: All module exported functions called by inline UI event handlers are imported and bound to `window` in `js/app.js`.

app.js.description: Application entry point, initializes Supabase client, binds exported module functions to `window`, manages view toggling (`switchView`), and sets up midnight business date polling.

frontdesk.js.description: Frontdesk dashboard, DataGrid table rendering, 14-day Tape Chart matrix, room forecast availability, drag-and-drop room assignments, and unassigned reservations drawer.

reservation.js.description: Reservation lifecycle management, quick/advanced search, room category lookup, ID document compression/webcam capture upload to Supabase Storage (`guest_documents`), group quantity handling, and physical room conflict checking.

folio.js.description: Guest and Master Folio accounting, charge and payment posting, bill transfers between folios (`rpc_transfer_folio_transaction`), void transaction audit trails, routing rules, and checkout validation.

cashier.js.description: Cashier shift management (OPEN, CLOSED), blind drop cash count modal, over/short variance calculation, 4-section cashier shift summary printable report, and denomination calculations.

night_audit.js.description: End-of-day Night Audit execution, pre-audit validation checklist (`fn_pre_night_audit_check`), EOD Flash Report generation, auto room charge posting, and business date rollover.

group.js.description: B2B Group booking split management (`rpc_split_group_reservation`), group master folios, corporate profile linking, group deposit management, and rooming list handling.

guestProfiles.js.description: Guest Card Files (GCF) master database CRUD, profile autocomplete search, stay history tracking, and duplicate profile handling.

operations.js.description: Housekeeping status management (Clean, Dirty, Inspected, Out of Order) and room operational controls.

reports.js.description: Financial and operational reporting suite, Daily Revenue Report (DRR), market segment analytics, and occupancy statistics.

settings.js.description: Property management configuration, room types, physical rooms, rate structures, tax & service rules, meal plans, extra charge catalog, and market segments.

shift.js.description: Cashier shift logbooks and session persistence utilities.

guestService.js.description: Abstraction service layer for GCF lookup, search, and reservation profile linking.

formatters.js.description: Utility formatters for Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) currency formatting, date manipulation, and string sanitization.

core_relationships.multi_room_reservation_split: Parent reservation splits into child reservations linked via `parent_reservation_id` and `group_booking_id`.

rpc_functions.rpc_post_folio_transaction: Posts CHARGE or PAYMENT to a folio, inheriting current hotel business date and active cashier session ID.
rpc_functions.rpc_transfer_folio_transaction: Transfers selected transactions between guest folios or to master folios using atomic reversal offset entries. Expects `p_transaction_ids` array of UUID strings.
rpc_functions.rpc_void_folio_transaction: Soft-deletes a transaction by setting `is_void = true`, `void_reason`, `voided_by`, and `voided_at`.
rpc_functions.rpc_open_cashier_shift: Opens a new cashier shift session with opening float.
rpc_functions.rpc_close_cashier_shift: Closes an active cashier shift with declared cash and calculates over/short variance.
rpc_functions.rpc_split_group_reservation: Splits a parent reservation (`qty > 1`) into individual child reservations (`qty = 1`).
rpc_functions.rpc_process_checkout: Validates zero balance, sets reservation status to `CHECKED_OUT`, and updates room status to `Dirty`.
rpc_functions.rpc_get_available_physical_rooms: Queries available physical rooms for given date range and room type.
rpc_functions.fn_pre_night_audit_check: Validates pre-audit readiness (checks open cashier shifts, pending arrivals, pending departures).
rpc_functions.fn_execute_night_audit: Posts daily room charges, advances `system_settings.current_hotel_date`, and logs `night_audit_history`.

blind_drop_method.description: During shift close, system expected cash is hidden from the cashier. Closing triggers Denomination Calculator modal where cashier enters physical cash counts. System expected cash and over/short variance are computed upon submission.

formula.system_net_cash: Total Cash Payments - Total Paid Out
formula.remittance_amount: Total Declared Cash - Petty Cash Retained
formula.over_short: Total Declared Cash - System Expected Cash

business_date_sovereignty.description: All operational and financial transactions anchor to `current_hotel_date` from `system_settings`, NOT local client machine time.

void_audit_trail.description: Hard-deleting financial records is strictly prohibited. Voiding sets `is_void = true` with mandatory void reason and user details, retaining record for audit trails.

checkout_balance_enforcement.description: Checkout (`rpc_process_checkout`) requires `balance == 0`. Outstanding balances must be settled or transferred to a Master/AR folio first.

client_side_fallback.description: Modules wrap Supabase RPC stored procedure calls in try/catch blocks with direct table query fallbacks if RPC endpoints are unavailable or return schema errors.

paymaster_and_nsg.description: Paymaster/Virtual rooms use room numbers prefixed with 'PM-' (case-insensitive) and `is_virtual = true`. Non-stay guests use `guest_type = 'Non-Staying Guest'`.

cashier_session_persistence.description: Active shift state is persisted in `localStorage` (`activeShiftId`, `cashierName`, `shiftName`). All folio postings inherit active `cashier_session_id`.

developer_guidelines.inline_event_handlers: When creating or modifying UI components called via HTML `onclick` or `onchange`, export the function in its module and bind it to `window` in `js/app.js`.
developer_guidelines.foreign_key_sanitization: Ensure foreign key references like `guest_card_id` and `guest_profile_id` are passed as `null` rather than empty strings `""` or `0` to prevent PostgREST foreign key errors.
developer_guidelines.postgrest_explicit_joins: Use explicit relationship syntax when querying embedded resources (e.g. `guest_card_files!fk_reservations_guest_card(...)`).
developer_guidelines.verification_procedure: Always verify state changes using read-only inspect tools after editing files. Run automated Python Playwright/pytest verification scripts when testing UI and API behavior.
